faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.a1: You make a single payment and immediately receive a unique License API Key. This activates Jasper Desktop permanently with no hidden recurring fees.
faq.q2: Do I need to pay for Gemini API?
faq.a2: No! Jasper connects directly to your Google AI Studio API key, which offers generous free quotas for daily personal usage.
faq.q3: Is it safe to run on my operating system?
faq.a3: Yes. Jasper is built on strict Zero-Trust principles with sandboxed interpreters, SSRF blocking, and automatic clipboard redaction.
